task_1.title: Add missing Python <3.11 typing_extensions runtime dependency
task_1.description: Version 2.12.1 fixes a packaging/runtime regression introduced in 2.12.0 where Python versions below 3.11 could fail during import because the library now relies on typing_extensions for Never but did not declare that dependency.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that upgrading to 2.12.1 restores successful library import and normal runtime loading on Python versions earlier than 3.11 by providing the required typing support dependency.

expectation.grounded: For Python < 3.11, installing and importing the package should succeed without a ModuleNotFoundError for typing_extensions after upgrading to 2.12.1. The package's published dependency metadata should include typing_extensions for Python versions that do not provide typing.Never in the standard library. Python 3.11 and newer should continue to rely on the standard library typing module without requiring this backport dependency.
expectation.conceptual: The upgrade should make the library usable again on older supported Python runtimes. Users on Python versions below 3.11 should be able to install and import the package normally, while newer Python versions should keep their existing behavior.

constraints.grounded: Do not change the library's public API or require consumers to add manual workarounds for the missing dependency. The fix should only address the missing runtime dependency for Python < 3.11 and should not introduce an unnecessary dependency requirement for Python 3.11+.
constraints.conceptual: The change should be a targeted compatibility fix. It must not alter normal library usage or add avoidable dependency burden to environments that already provide the needed typing support.

behavior: On Python versions earlier than 3.11, importing the library should no longer fail because typing_extensions is unavailable.
The package should declare the extra runtime dependency needed to support Never on Python < 3.11.
On Python 3.11 and later, the library should continue to load using the standard library typing support without changed user-facing behavior.
acceptance_criteria: When a user installs version 2.12.1 on Python 3.10 or another Python version below 3.11, importing the library should complete without raising ModuleNotFoundError for typing_extensions.
When a user upgrades from 2.12.0 to 2.12.1 on Python < 3.11, the previous runtime loading failure caused by the missing typing_extensions dependency should be resolved.
When a user installs version 2.12.1 on Python 3.11 or newer, the package should remain importable without requiring an additional typing backport dependency.
